name: Clyde Arellano
headline: I build backend systems and APIs that stay reliable, maintainable, and fast as they scale.
tagline: Backend developer with 5+ years in PHP, Laravel, and MySQL — designing REST APIs, data models, and the services behind web and mobile apps.
about: I'm a backend-focused software developer with over five years of professional experience building and maintaining web applications using PHP and modern backend technologies. My expertise includes Laravel, CakePHP, MySQL, Redis, Docker, and RESTful API development. I enjoy designing clean architectures, solving complex business problems, and building systems that are secure, scalable, and maintainable. Currently, I work as a Backend Developer at Forty Degrees Celsius Inc. while continuously exploring AI-assisted development, automation, and modern software engineering practices.

experience.title: Backend Developer
experience.detail: Develop and maintain large-scale backend systems, implement new features, optimize existing services, troubleshoot production issues, and collaborate with cross-functional teams to deliver reliable software.

experience.title: Software Engineer
experience.detail: Developed and maintained data processing solutions using Perl and C++. Built automation scripts and transformed client data into XML for enterprise publishing workflows.

experience.title: Freelance Backend & Software Developer
experience.detail: Designed and developed custom web applications, REST APIs, database solutions, and business systems for various clients using PHP, MySQL, JavaScript, and modern development tools.

projects.name: Teacher Document Review System
projects.problem: Educational organizations needed a centralized platform for document submissions, reviews, comments, approvals, and revision tracking.
projects.outcome: Designed a document management workflow featuring submissions, reviewer feedback, approval pipelines, notifications, and comprehensive status tracking.

technicalDetails.architecture: A Laravel application organized around document submissions, reviewer feedback, approval stages, notifications, and status history.
responsibilities: Designed the document review and approval workflow.
Implemented the backend flows for submissions, feedback, approvals, notifications, and status tracking.
engineeringNotes: Structured the workflow so reviewers and submitters can follow each document through its review lifecycle.

projects.clientSummary: A central workspace for submitting, reviewing, revising, and approving educational documents.
projects.clientProblem: Document reviews were difficult to coordinate when submissions, feedback, revisions, and approvals lived in separate places.
projects.clientSolution: Built one system where teachers can submit documents and reviewers can provide feedback, request changes, and approve work.
projects.benefit: Keeps the full review process organized and makes each document's current status easier to understand.

projects.name: FETCH ME
projects.problem: Passengers needed an efficient way to connect with nearby drivers through a centralized booking platform.
projects.outcome: Developed a ride-matching platform featuring booking workflows, driver-passenger matching logic, and real-time ride status updates using Laravel and Vue.js.

technicalDetails.architecture: A Laravel backend and MySQL database support a Vue.js interface for ride booking, driver-passenger matching, and ride status updates.
responsibilities: Built the booking workflow and driver-passenger matching logic.
Developed the backend and user-facing application.
engineeringNotes: Kept booking and ride-status changes coordinated across passenger and driver workflows.

projects.clientSummary: A booking platform that helps passengers find nearby drivers and follow the progress of a ride.
projects.clientProblem: Passengers needed a simpler way to request rides and connect with available drivers.
projects.clientSolution: Created a centralized platform for booking, matching passengers with drivers, and sharing ride status updates.
projects.benefit: Gives passengers and drivers one clear place to coordinate a ride from request through completion.

projects.name: Academic Document Repository System
projects.problem: Academic research documents were difficult to organize, secure, and retrieve across different colleges and departments.
projects.outcome: Built a role-based document repository that streamlines uploading, searching, downloading, and managing academic research with structured classification and secure access controls.

technicalDetails.architecture: A Laravel and MySQL backend with a Vue.js interface, structured document classification, role-based permissions, search, and download flows.
responsibilities: Developed the repository's backend and frontend.
Implemented document organization, search, download, and access-control features.
engineeringNotes: Used role-based access to control how academic documents are managed and retrieved.

projects.clientSummary: A secure, searchable home for academic research across colleges and departments.
projects.clientProblem: Research documents were hard to organize and retrieve consistently across different academic units.
projects.clientSolution: Built a shared repository where authorized users can upload, classify, search, download, and manage research documents.
projects.benefit: Makes academic work easier to find while keeping document access and management organized.

projects.name: NORSU-BSC ID Configurator System
projects.problem: Managing student ID information manually made updates, customization, and record maintenance inefficient.
projects.outcome: Developed a centralized ID management platform allowing administrators to configure student records and ID templates through an intuitive web interface.

technicalDetails.architecture: A Laravel and MySQL application with a Vue.js administration interface for student records and configurable ID templates.
responsibilities: Developed the administrative frontend and backend.
Implemented student record and ID template configuration workflows.

projects.clientSummary: An administration system for managing student information and configuring ID templates.
projects.clientProblem: Manual student ID preparation made record changes and template updates time-consuming.
projects.clientSolution: Created a central interface where administrators can maintain student records and configure ID layouts.
projects.benefit: Simplifies routine ID updates and keeps student information in one manageable system.

projects.name: Campus Bulletin & Notification System
projects.problem: Students often missed important campus announcements due to fragmented communication channels.
projects.outcome: Built web and mobile applications enabling administrators to publish announcements and send real-time notifications directly to students.

technicalDetails.architecture: A Laravel backend supports a Vue.js web application and Java mobile application for publishing announcements and delivering notifications.
responsibilities: Built the web, mobile, and backend parts of the system.
Implemented announcement publishing and student notification flows.
engineeringNotes: Connected web-based publishing with mobile delivery so updates reach students through one coordinated system.

projects.clientSummary: A web and mobile communication system for publishing campus updates directly to students.
projects.clientProblem: Important announcements were spread across different channels and could easily be missed.
projects.clientSolution: Built tools for administrators to publish updates and send timely notifications to students.
projects.benefit: Creates a clearer communication channel between campus administrators and students.

projects.name: ASL Recognition System
projects.problem: Communication between individuals using American Sign Language and non-signers can be difficult without real-time translation tools.
projects.outcome: Built a real-time ASL recognition system using MediaPipe hand landmarks and TensorFlow models to accurately classify multiple hand gestures from live camera input.

technicalDetails.architecture: A Python computer-vision pipeline extracts hand landmarks from live camera input with MediaPipe and classifies gestures with TensorFlow models.
responsibilities: Built the real-time hand tracking and gesture-classification pipeline.
Integrated camera input, landmark extraction, and model predictions.
engineeringNotes: Processed live camera frames to support immediate gesture classification.

projects.clientSummary: A camera-based tool that recognizes multiple American Sign Language hand gestures in real time.
projects.clientProblem: People who do not understand American Sign Language can find it difficult to interpret signed communication.
projects.clientSolution: Created a system that watches hand movements through a camera and identifies supported gestures as they are made.
projects.benefit: Demonstrates how computer vision can help make signed communication more accessible.
